tasks.short: Prepare flight, passenger, inventory and cabin problem reports

steps.what: Gather flight identifiers, inventory observations, equipment conditions and passenger problem facts
Prepare reports from verified flight, inventory and problem information

loop.purpose: Draft narrative problem sections while copying checked factual fields
loop.input: Verified report facts and approved report template
loop.output: Draft report separating observations, passenger accounts and unresolved issues
loop.check: Attendant checks route, ticket references, quantities, equipment facts and narrative meaning against the source, preserving uncertainty and attribution
loop.stop: One correction then manual drafting if any material mismatch remains
loop.why_not_simpler: Field reuse is deterministic but faithfully condensing narrative passenger problems requires semantic interpretation

steps.what: Verify the complete report and submit the accepted version

tasks.design: Configure reusable report fields in {OPS_SYSTEM} before adding bounded narrative drafting from verified notes. The attendant retains fact gathering and the complete final check before submitting a specific report version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing flight and observation information may be copied into report sections repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital aviation logs support prefilled fields; bounded drafting can assist narrative sections.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate attribution and sensitive passenger details require careful verification.
tasks.human_edge: The attendant distinguishes observed facts from reported concerns.
tasks.altitude: Less report drafting; accountability for submitted facts remains human.

reach.learn: Accurate attribution and minimal necessary detail
